verdict.rationale: Receipts are a fair question for a payments/POS product like SumUp, so the axis applies. However, the pack has no first-party documentation of email, SMS or printed receipts, nor of card-network receipt compliance. The only related item is a community report of a developer hacking together their own receipt-printer integration via the public API, which is a DIY workaround rather than a SumUp receipt capability.
